The base stylesheet string injected into every component shadow root. UX notes per rule group:

  • :host { display:block; font-family/color } — every component is a block-level, correctly-typeset box by default;
  • skeleton-* — grey placeholder boxes with a diagonal shimmer (::before gradient sweeping left→right every 1.8s) so loading feels alive; color: transparent hides the reserve-space text;
  • skeleton-layer — absolutely-positioned WebGL canvas overlaying the placeholders (has-skeleton-layer pauses the CSS shimmer to save paint);
  • skeleton-content-in — 0.45s fade when real content lands;
  • reduced-motion — collapses all animation/transition durations to ~0ms so motion-sensitive users see instant state changes.
